description_en: Submit a job to offline generate a 3D digital human video based on a piece of text. This API immediately returns a TaskUuid as the unique identifier for the submitted job. You can later use this TaskUuid to invoke the query and cancel job APIs
description_zh: 提交根据一段文本离线生成3D数字人视频任务，该接口会立即返回一个TaskUuid作为本次提交任务的唯一id，后续可以根据TaskUuid调用查询和取消任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun avatar submit-text-to-3d-avatar-video-task --tenant-id 1 --app AppId=3d95xx946a --title '这是一个示例标题' --text '这是一个示例文本' --video-info '{"IsSubtitles":true,"SubtitleEmbedded":false,"BackgroundImageUrl":"可访问的公网url地址","SubtitleStyle":{"OutlineColor":"#FFFFFF00","Size":36,"Color":"#000000FF","Y":984,"Name":"alibabapuhuiti"},"AlphaFormat":1,"IsAlpha":false,"Resolution":1}' --avatar-info Angle=0 IndustryCode=default Locate=0 Code=CH_xxxxxxx --audio-info PitchRate=0 SampleRate=16000 Volume=0 Voice=guijie SpeechRate=0 --callback false --callback-params xxx_:_xxx --ext-params xxx_:_xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTextTo3DAvatarVideoTask

fields.help_en:
Whether the alpha channel is required. Default value: false.  
- true: Enables the alpha channel. The video format can be specified by AlphaFormat and supports WebM, MOV, and MP4.  
- false: Disables the alpha channel. The video format is MP4.
fields.help_zh:
是否需要透明通道， 默认false
- true： 开启透明通道，视频格式可通过AlphaFormat指定，支持webm、mov、mp4
- false：不开启透明通道，视频格式为mp4
fields.name: is_alpha

fields.help_en:
Alpha channel format. Default value: 1.  
- 1: webm  
- 2: mov  
- 3: mp4

><notice>When isAlpha is false, this field is ignored. MOV format transparent video files result in very large file sizes and are not recommended. Use WebM or MP4 instead.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
透明通道格式 ，默认值1
- 1：webm  
- 2：mov
- 3：mp4

><notice>当isAlpha为false时，该字段忽略。mov格式的透明视频文件大小会非常大，不推荐使用，建议使用webm或者mp4。></notice>
fields.name: alpha_format

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to generate captions. Default value: true  
- true: Captions are generated in **ASS** file format and provided as a separate subtitle file with a download link  
- false: Captions are not generated  

><warning>This field is deprecated. Regardless of whether true or false is specified, a separate subtitle file will always be generated. Use the SubtitleEmbedded field to control whether captions are merged into the video.</warning>
fields.help_zh:
是否需要字幕，默认值：true
- true： 生成字幕，字幕文件格式为**ass**文件，会作为独立文件提供下载链接进行下载
- false：不生成字幕

><warning>该字段已废弃，传入true和false都会生成单独字幕文件，新增SubtitleEmbedded字段可控制是否将字幕合并到视频中。></warning>
fields.name: is_subtitles

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to merge captions into the video. Default value: false  
- true: Captions are merged into the video  
- false: Captions are not merged into the video
fields.help_zh:
是否将字幕合并到视频中，默认值：false
- true：字幕合并到视频中
- false：字幕不合并到视频中

fields.help_en:
The resolution of the generated video. The following options are currently supported:  
- 1: 720 × 1280 (portrait)  
- 2: 1280 × 720 (landscape)  
- 3: 1080 × 1920 (portrait)  
- 4: 1920 × 1080 (landscape)

A valid and accessible URL for the background image. The resolution of the background image must match the resolution of the generated video.  
- Currently supported image formats are JPG, JPEG, and PNG

有效可访问的url背景图片地址，背景图片的分辨率必须要与生成的视频分辨率保持一致
- 目前支持jpg，jpeg，png的图片格式

fields.help_en:
The speech rate of the TTS voice. Valid values: -500 to 500. If not specified, the default value configured in the asset is used.

The speech rate values [-500, 0, 500] correspond to speed multipliers [0.5, 1.0, 2.0], respectively.

- -500 represents 0.5× the base speech rate.
- 0 represents 1.0× the base speech rate. The base rate is the model's default synthesized speech speed, which varies slightly by speaker and is approximately four Chinese characters per second.
- 500 represents 2.0× the base speech rate.

The calculation method is as follows:

For 0.8× speed: (1 - 1/0.8) / 0.002 = -125  
For 1.2× speed: (1 - 1/1.2) / 0.001 = 166
fields.help_zh:
TTS播报声音语速，取值范围：-500～500，不传则使用资产中配置的默认值。

[-500, 0, 500] 对应的语速倍速区间为 [0.5, 1.0, 2.0]。

-500表示基准语速的0.5倍速；
0表示基准语速的1倍速。1倍速是指模型默认输出的合成语速，语速会依据每一个发音人略有不同，大概每秒钟4个字左右；
500表示基准语速的2倍速；

计算方法如下：

0.8倍速（1-1/0.8)/0.002 = -125

1.2倍速（1-1/1.2)/0.001 = 166
fields.name: speech_rate

fields.help_en: The volume of the TTS voice. Valid values: 0 to 100. If not specified, the default value configured in the asset is used
fields.help_zh: TTS播报声音音量，取值范围：0～100，不传则使用资产中配置的默认值
